package fixture

import "testing"

// This file is data for TestOKAloneScannerSelfTest (a .txt file: it is neither
// compiled nor scanned by the rule itself). Every line that must be flagged
// carries the marker "want"; no other line may be flagged.

func TestOKAloneNot(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if !rep.OK() { // want
		return
	}
}

func TestOKAloneFalse(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if rep.OK() == false { // want
		return
	}
}

func TestOKAloneFalseReversed(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if false == rep.OK() { // want
		return
	}
}

func TestOKAloneInClosure(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("x", func(t *testing.T) {
		if rep := verify(t); !rep.OK() { // want
			return
		}
	})
}

func TestOKWithRequireProblem(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if !rep.OK() {
		evidencetest.RequireProblem(t, rep, "recovered kind")
	}
}

func TestOKWithRequireProblems(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if rep.OK() == false {
		RequireProblems(t, rep, "a", "b")
	}
}

func TestOKWithLineHelper(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if !rep.OK() {
		requireProblemLine(t, rep, "x")
	}
}

func TestOKPositiveIsNotAFinding(t *testing.T) {
	rep := verify(t)
	if rep.OK() {
		t.Fatal("clean")
	}
	_ = !other.Valid()
}
